site.title: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.heading: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.description: Rose Hallgren is a multidisciplinary architect and designer in Stockholm, working between traditional craft and contemporary architecture.
site.intro:
I am an architect and designer in Stockholm. I work between drawing and making: a bathing jetty, a stage set, a tufted wall, a glazed vessel. What interests me is the point where a plan has to become a material decision. Weaving and ceramics are not finishes applied at the end of that; they are how I work out what a space should be.

Together with Jenny Hedén Malm I run Fanfaluca Collective, an architecture collective spanning Stockholm and Barcelona, and I am one of four behind C.O.U.A. (The Collective of Unexpected Architecture), a studio for unexpected art and design. I also work with Svartljus, a Stockholm-based lighting collective making bespoke light sculptures and immersive experiences for museums, events and festivals, and with Kulturföreningen PLX.

My studio is at Åsögatan 122 in Stockholm, shared with SMASH and collaborator Jonas Johansson.
